mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the federal funds rate below 2.0% triggers a monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not fall below 2.0% in the preceding month, or 20-day forward returns during such periods are not significantly higher than average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in economic demand (GDPC1) and contraction in supply (INDPRO) creates a demand-driven upturn, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of rising GDPC1 and falling INDPRO does not predict positive 20-day returns more effectively than either proxy alone (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid improvement in labor market conditions, indicated by a 0.5 percentage point rise in UNRATE, signals recovery and triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.5pp in a month but 20-day forward returns remain negative or insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) above historical averages over 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investor confidence strengthens.
failure_condition: 60-day S&P 500 returns are not significantly higher than average during periods of sustained GDPC1 growth (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in the supply index (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals weakening production capacity, prompting increased demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not fall below 95.0 in the preceding month, or 20-day forward returns during such periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) combined with improving labor market conditions (UNRATE < 6.0%), conflicting signals may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with improving labor market
failure_condition: In the regime of monetary tightening with improving labor market, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and UNRATE < 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by high GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3% MoM) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%), investors anticipate sustained gains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During late-cycle expansion periods defined by GDPC1 growth >3% and CPIAUCSL <2.5%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
